environment.description: Same Go microservice on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. Traffic arrives via internal ALB (scheme=internal). S3 access is routed through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint with a restrictive endpoint policy. The endpoint policy uses a condition key aws:sourceVpce to restrict which principals can call s3:GetObject, and critically includes a StringEquals condition on s3:prefix requiring the key to match a pattern derived from a signed HMAC of the request timestamp (verified server-side before the S3 call). The VPC endpoint policy also has a Deny statement for any request where the User-Agent header (passed via the SDK) does not match the service's compiled binary signature hash. The VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached, so the only path to S3 is through this endpoint. Additionally, the security group on the Fargate task only allows inbound from the internal ALB's security group on port 8080, and the internal ALB is only accessible from a separate management VPC via VPC peering with a route table entry limited to 10.0.0.0/16.

config.network: Private subnet, internal ALB, no IGW, no NAT
config.alb_access: Internal ALB accessible only from 10.0.0.0/16 via VPC peering
